```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE)
```

```{r libraries}
library(tidyverse)
library(here)
library(dplyr)
library(brms)
library(bridgesampling)
library(xtable)
library(patchwork)
library(lingtypology) # Glottolog version 5.2
library(stringdist)

select <- dplyr::select
```

This notebook contains analyses of oak and acorn terms across North American languages, collected by Brown (2001). 

First load oak-related terms and species occurrence data. 

```{r n and occurrence data, include=TRUE}

oak_raw <- read_csv(here("data", "oak_occurrences.csv"), show_col_types = FALSE)

oak <- oak_raw %>%
  group_by(glottocode) %>%
  # estimate number of species for each language
  mutate(n = n_distinct(species)) %>%
  ungroup()

# see if the area size and number of species are correlated
check <- oak %>% 
  group_by(glottocode, langname, n, area_km2) %>%
  summarise(total = sum(occurrence, na.rm=TRUE)) %>%
  ungroup()
cor.test(check$n, check$area_km2)
# looks good 

oak <- oak %>%
  select(glottocode, species, occurrence, n, GOT, SOT, AGR, GAT, SAT, ACN, langname, family, longitude, latitude, subarea)
# n: number of distinct species
# GOT: presence of oak generic
# SOT: # of oak specifics
# AGR: subsistence strategy
# GAT: presence of acorn generic
# SAT: # of acorn specifics
# ACN: acorn use
# longitude: Glottolog longitude
# latitude: Glottolog latitude
# subarea: assigned sub area by Brown

oak <- oak %>%
  # some languages were assigned the same glottocode, so we add their name to distinguish
  mutate(glottocode = if_else(n > 1, str_c(glottocode, "_", langname), glottocode)) %>%
  select(-langname)

oak <- oak %>%
  group_by(glottocode) %>%
  # estimate total occurrence of oak species
  mutate(total_occ = sum(occurrence)) %>%
  ungroup()

oak <- oak %>%
  mutate(
    AGR = recode(AGR, "hunter-gatherer" = "forager", "agriculturalist" = "farmer"),
    ACN = recode(ACN, "user" = "user", "nonuser" = "non-user")
  )

oak <- oak %>%
  # estimate proportion of occurrence of a single species
  mutate(p_i = occurrence / total_occ)

oak <- oak %>%
  group_by(glottocode) %>%
  # estimate Shannon index based on that proportion
  mutate(H = -sum(p_i * log(p_i))) %>%
  ungroup()

# assign system types
oak <- oak %>%
  mutate(
    oak_system = case_when(
      SOT > 0 & GOT == "absent" ~ "spec.only",
      SOT == 0 & GOT == "present" ~ "gen.only",
      SOT > 0 & GOT == "present" ~ "two.level",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    )
  )

oak <- oak %>%
  mutate(
    acorn_system = case_when(
      SAT > 0 & GAT == "absent" ~ "spec.only",
      SAT == 0 & GAT == "present" ~ "gen.only",
      SAT > 0 & GAT == "present" ~ "two.level",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    )
  )

oakacorn <- oak %>%
  select(glottocode, n, GOT, SOT, AGR, GAT, SAT, ACN, H, oak_system, acorn_system, family, longitude, latitude, subarea) %>%
  distinct()
```

It should be noted that Brown (2001) included languages that have at least two different specific terms and excluded languages that have only one species. According to our approximation of number of species present, the smallest number is 3.

Brown (2001) noted that the Handbook of North American Indians (Sturtevant 1978), Handbook of Middle American Indians (Wauchope 1964), the Indians of the Southeastern United States (Swanton 1946) were mainly used for assigning subsistence and acorn use (page 123). We'll first confirm these variables.

## Subsistence and acorn use

We'll use Native American Ethnobotany DB data which was based on the book Native American Ethnobotany (Moerman 1998) and D-PLACE dataset derived from Jorgensen 1980 'Western Indians' (Jorgensen, J. 2025) to confirm acorn use. 

```{r}
naeb_lang <- read_csv(here("data", "naeb_tribes.csv"), show_col_types = FALSE)
length(unique(naeb_lang$tribe_name)) # 291 cultures total

naeb_raw <- read_csv(here("data", "naeb_quercus.csv"), show_col_types = FALSE)
length(unique(naeb_raw$culture)) # 93 has recorded use of oak

# first map those 291 cultures with glottocodes
naeb_cultures <- naeb_lang %>% distinct(tribe_name) %>% pull(tribe_name)

# take language data from Glottolog
glotto_langs <- glottolog %>%
  distinct(glottocode, language, level)

normalize <- function(x) tolower(trimws(x))

find_glottocode <- function(culture, gl) {
  # 1. Exact match
  hit <- gl %>% filter(normalize(language) == normalize(culture))
  if (nrow(hit) == 1) return(tibble(culture = culture, glottocode = hit$glottocode, match = "exact"))

  # 2. "X, Y" → "Y X" reorder (e.g. "Apache, Western" → "Western Apache")
  if (grepl(",", culture)) {
    parts     <- str_split(culture, ",\\s*")[[1]]
    reordered <- paste(rev(parts), collapse = " ")
    hit <- gl %>% filter(normalize(language) == normalize(reordered))
    if (nrow(hit) == 1) return(tibble(culture = culture, glottocode = hit$glottocode, match = "reordered"))
  }

  # 3. Remove dialect/variant suffixes in parentheses (e.g. "Tzotzil (Zinacantan)" → "Tzotzil")
  stripped <- str_remove(culture, "\\s*\\(.*\\)")
  if (stripped != culture) {
    hit <- gl %>% filter(normalize(language) == normalize(stripped))
    if (nrow(hit) == 1) return(tibble(culture = culture, glottocode = hit$glottocode, match = "stripped"))
  }

  tibble(culture = culture, glottocode = NA_character_, match = "none")
}

culture_glotto <- map_dfr(naeb_cultures, find_glottocode, gl = glotto_langs) %>%
  left_join(glottolog %>% select(glottocode, language), by = "glottocode")

# let's try to string match Brown languages with those with no glottocode
glotto_none <- culture_glotto %>%
  filter(is.na(glottocode))

oak_names    <- unique(oak_raw$langname)        
none_names   <- unique(glotto_none$culture)         

# For each unmatched name, find the closest name
matches <- tibble(none_name = none_names) %>%
  mutate(
    best_match = oak_names[amatch(none_name, oak_names, method = "jw", maxDist = 0.25)],
    dist       = stringdist(none_name, best_match, method = "jw")
  ) %>%
  arrange(dist) %>%
  left_join(oak_raw %>% distinct(glottocode, best_match=langname), by = "best_match") %>%
  # these cases seem to be wrong
  mutate(glottocode = ifelse(best_match %in% c("Nisenan", "Achumawi", "Plains Miwok", "Cuicatec"), NA, glottocode)) %>%
  mutate(glottocode = ifelse(best_match == "Klamath" & none_name == "Kamia", NA, glottocode))

culture_glotto_full <- culture_glotto %>%
  filter(!is.na(glottocode)) %>%
  distinct(culture, glottocode) %>%
  bind_rows(matches %>%
              filter(!is.na(glottocode)) %>%
                       select(culture=none_name, glottocode))
length(unique(culture_glotto_full$culture))  # 145 cultures have glottocodes assigned

oak_glotto <- oak_raw %>%
  distinct(glottocode, langname)

oak_with_naeb <- oak_glotto %>%
  left_join(culture_glotto_full, by = "glottocode", relationship = "many-to-many")

oak_with_naeb %>%
  filter(!is.na(culture)) %>%
  nrow()# 40 of the Brown languages have some information in NAEB

# we estimate usage diversity per language in Brown data
naeb_quercus_by_glotto <- naeb_raw %>%
  left_join(oak_with_naeb %>% filter(!is.na(culture)) %>% select(culture, glottocode),
            by = "culture") %>%
  filter(!is.na(glottocode)) %>%
  group_by(glottocode) %>%
  summarise(
    naeb_n_uses    = n_distinct(paste(use_category, use_subcategory)),
    naeb_n_species = n_distinct(paste(scientific_name, common_name)),
    naeb_richness  = n_distinct(paste(scientific_name, use_category, use_subcategory)),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# languages in oak_with_naeb that have a culture match but no oak records get zero
glottos_in_naeb <- oak_with_naeb %>% filter(!is.na(culture)) %>% distinct(glottocode)

naeb_quercus_by_glotto <- glottos_in_naeb %>%
  left_join(naeb_quercus_by_glotto, by = c("glottocode")) %>%
  mutate(across(starts_with("naeb_"), ~ replace_na(.x, 0)))

oakacorn <- oakacorn %>%
  mutate(glottocode_base = str_extract(glottocode, "^[a-z]{4}[0-9]{4}")) %>%
  left_join(naeb_quercus_by_glotto, by = c("glottocode_base" = "glottocode"), relationship = "many-to-many") %>%
  select(-glottocode_base)

```

Now add data from D-Place:

```{r}
va <- read_csv(here("data/wnai", "variables.csv"), show_col_types = FALSE)
so <- read_csv(here("data/wnai", "societies.csv"), show_col_types = FALSE)
da <- read_csv(here("data/wnai", "data.csv"), show_col_types = FALSE)
co <- read_csv(here("data/wnai", "codes.csv"), show_col_types = FALSE)

wnai_acorn <- da %>%
  filter(Var_ID == "WNAI156") %>%
  select(Soc_ID, Var_ID, Value) %>%
  inner_join(so %>% select(Soc_ID=ID, glottocode=Glottocode), by = "Soc_ID") %>%
  # filter out missing data 
  filter(!is.na(Value)) %>%
  select(glottocode, acorn_use=Value) %>%
  mutate(acorn_use = ifelse(acorn_use == "Acorns not eaten", 0, 1)) %>%
  unique()
  
wnai_oak <- da %>%
  filter(Var_ID %in% c(paste0("WNAI", 11:21))) %>%
  select(Soc_ID, Var_ID, Value) %>%
  inner_join(so %>% select(Soc_ID=ID, glottocode=Glottocode), by = "Soc_ID") %>%
  # filter out missing data 
  filter(!is.na(Value))  %>%
  select(glottocode, Var_ID, oak_species=Value) %>%
  mutate(oak_species = ifelse(oak_species == "Absent", 0, 1)) %>%
  unique() %>%
  filter(oak_species == 1) %>%
  group_by(glottocode) %>%
  summarise(n_wnai = n_distinct(Var_ID)) %>%
  ungroup()
  
oakacorn <- oakacorn %>%
  mutate(glottocode_base = str_extract(glottocode, "^[a-z]{4}[0-9]{4}")) %>%
  left_join(wnai_acorn, by = c("glottocode_base" = "glottocode")) %>%
  left_join(wnai_oak,   by = c("glottocode_base" = "glottocode")) %>%
  select(-glottocode_base)

oakacorn %>% filter(!is.na(n_wnai)) %>% nrow()
# 21 languages have info in WNAI
```

In general, we'll assume that a particular culture has acorn use if any of the relevant sources indicate so (in other words, Brown's sources as well as two additional sources considered here). Let's first look at the acorn use:

```{r}
oakacorn %>%
  filter(ACN == "non-user", acorn_use == 1)
# Clallam has acorn use in WNAI dataset

oakacorn %>%
  filter(ACN == "non-user", naeb_n_uses > 0)
# Comanche has acorn use in NAEB dataset

# in general it looks sources tend to converge (many usage cases from WNAI and NAEB are also recorded as user in Brown data)
# we'll fix these two languages
oakacorn <- oakacorn %>%
  mutate(ACN = ifelse(glottocode %in% c("coma1245_Comanche", "clal1241_Clallam"), "user", ACN))
```

WNAI has also listed some oak species and if they are present in the culture's area. Let's have a look at the relationship between our measure and the number of oak species recorded as present in WNAI. Note that our measure is much more detailed in terms of oak species classification, but it has also some limitations.

```{r, fig.height=3, fig.width=3}
ggplot(oakacorn, aes(x = n_wnai, y = n)) + geom_point(alpha=0.3) + geom_smooth(method="lm") + theme_bw()
cor.test(oakacorn$n, oakacorn$n_wnai)
```

Finally, we'll use subsistence data from Khishigsuren et al. (2025), which was based on several sources (see sources column and associated description here: https://github.com/cskemp/lexical_elaboration/tree/main/rawdata/downloaded), to see if any discrepancies with subsistence strategy.

```{r}
subsistence <- read_csv(here("data", "subsistence.csv"), show_col_types = FALSE) 

oakacorn <- oakacorn %>%
  mutate(glottocode_base = str_extract(glottocode, "^[a-z]{4}[0-9]{4}")) %>%
  left_join(subsistence, by = c("glottocode_base" = "glottocode")) %>%
  select(-glottocode_base)

nrow(oakacorn[!is.na(oakacorn$subsistence), ])
# we have 62 language that has subsistence information in Khishigsuren data

oakacorn %>%
  filter(AGR == "forager", subsistence == "other")
# no forager cultures have otherwise indicated in Khishigsuren data

check <- oakacorn %>%
  filter(AGR == "farmer", subsistence == "hunter-gatherer")
# some farmer cultures have indicated as hunter-gatherers in Guldemann et al. (2020)

# we decided to follow Guldemann's classifications because they were primarily interested in identifying hunter-gatherer languages and more recent
oakacorn <- oakacorn %>%
 mutate(AGR = ifelse(!is.na(subsistence) & source =="guldemannmr_2020" & subsistence == "hunter-gatherer","forager", AGR))
```

## Explore the dataset

Before running statistical analysis, let's look at some descriptive statistics:

```{r}
oakacorn <- oakacorn %>%
  mutate(AGR_ACN = case_when(
      AGR == "forager" & ACN == "non-user" ~ "forager-nonuser",
      AGR == "forager" & ACN == "user"     ~ "forager-user",
      AGR == "farmer"  & ACN == "non-user" ~ "farmer-nonuser",
      AGR == "farmer"  & ACN == "user"     ~ "farmer-user",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ))

table(oakacorn$AGR, oakacorn$ACN) # 36 out 39 foragers are acorn users, 21 out of 39 farmers are acorn users
table(oakacorn$GOT) # 36 out 79 have oak generic
table(oakacorn$GAT) # 60 out of 71 have acorn generic
table(oakacorn$GOT, oakacorn$AGR_ACN) # forager-users tend to have absent of oak generic
table(oakacorn$GAT, oakacorn$AGR_ACN) # all (except for forager-nonuser) tend to have acorn generic
summary(oakacorn$SOT)
summary(oakacorn$SAT)
sd(oakacorn$SOT, na.rm=TRUE)
sd(oakacorn$SAT, na.rm=TRUE)
# on average, acorn specifics tend to be lower compared to oak specifics
oakacorn %>% group_by(AGR_ACN) %>%
  summarise(mean_SOT = mean(SOT, na.rm=TRUE),
            sd_SOT = sd(SOT, na.rm=TRUE),
            mean_SAT = mean(SAT, na.rm=TRUE),
            sd_SAT = sd(SAT, na.rm=TRUE)) %>% ungroup()
# both farmers and forager-users have similar SOT number
# forager-users tend to have higher SAT than farmers
cor.test(oakacorn$n, oakacorn$H) # 0.85
# n and H are strongly correlated, which is expected
```

Visualization through maps:

```{r fig_maps, fig.width=14, fig.height=14}
library(maps)

world_map <- map_data("world")

agr_acn_colors <- c(
  "forager-nonuser" = "#2166ac",
  "forager-user"    = "#74add1",
  "farmer-nonuser"  = "#d73027",
  "farmer-user"     = "#f46d43"
)

base_map <- list(
  geom_map(data = world_map, map = world_map,
           aes(long, lat, map_id = region),
           fill = "#e0e0e0", color = "white", linewidth = 0.1),
  coord_sf(xlim = c(-135, -60), ylim = c(8, 52)),
  theme_void(),
  theme(legend.position        = "none",
        plot.title             = element_text(size = 10, hjust = 0.5, margin = margin(b = 4)))
)

color_scale  <- scale_color_manual(values = agr_acn_colors, name = "")

# Shared color legend: invisible points so only the legend key renders
legend_row <- ggplot(
  tibble(AGR_ACN = factor(names(agr_acn_colors), levels = names(agr_acn_colors))),
  aes(x = AGR_ACN, y = 1, color = AGR_ACN)
) +
  geom_point(size = 0, alpha = 0) +
  labs(color = "") +
  color_scale +
  theme_void() +
  theme(legend.position  = "top",
        legend.direction = "horizontal",
        legend.title     = element_text(size = 10, face = "bold"),
        legend.text      = element_text(size = 9)) +
  guides(color = guide_legend(override.aes = list(shape = 16, size = 3, alpha = 1)))

# Small random jitter to reduce overlapping points (especially California)
set.seed(42)
oakacorn_jitter <- oakacorn %>%
  mutate(
    longitude = longitude + runif(n(), -2.5, 2.5),
    latitude  = latitude  + runif(n(), 2, 2)
  )

# Map 1: Oak system — hollow = GOT absent, filled = GOT present; size = SOT
p1 <- ggplot() +
  base_map +
  geom_point(
    data = oakacorn_jitter %>% filter(!is.na(GOT), !is.na(SOT)),
    aes(x = longitude, y = latitude,
        color = AGR_ACN, size = SOT + 1, shape = GOT),
    alpha = 0.8, stroke = 0.8
  ) +
  color_scale +
  scale_shape_manual(values = c("absent" = 1, "present" = 16), name = "oak generic") +
  scale_size_continuous(name = "# oak specifics", range = c(0.5, 2.5)) +
  guides(color = "none",
         shape = guide_legend(order = 1),
         size  = guide_legend(order = 2)) +
  ggtitle("Oak system")

# Map 2: Acorn system — hollow = GAT absent, filled = GAT present; size = SAT
p2 <- ggplot() +
  base_map +
  geom_point(
    data = oakacorn_jitter %>% filter(!is.na(GAT), !is.na(SAT)),
    aes(x = longitude, y = latitude,
        color = AGR_ACN, size = SAT + 1, shape = GAT),
    alpha = 0.8, stroke = 0.8
  ) +
  color_scale +
  scale_shape_manual(values = c("absent" = 1, "present" = 16), name = "acorn generic") +
  scale_size_continuous(name = "# acorn specifics", range = c(0.5, 2.5)) +
  guides(color = "none",
         shape = guide_legend(order = 1),
         size  = guide_legend(order = 2)) +
  ggtitle("Acorn system")

# Map 3: Oak species richness — size = n
p3 <- ggplot() +
  base_map +
  geom_point(
    data = oakacorn_jitter %>% filter(!is.na(n)),
    aes(x = longitude, y = latitude, color = AGR_ACN, size = n),
    shape = 16, alpha = 0.8
  ) +
  color_scale +
  scale_size_continuous(name = "# oak species", range = c(0.1, 2.5)) +
  guides(color = "none",
         size  = guide_legend(order = 1)) +
  ggtitle("Oak species richness")

# Map 4: Oak species Shannon diversity — size = H
p4 <- ggplot() +
  base_map +
  geom_point(
    data = oakacorn_jitter %>% filter(!is.na(H)),
    aes(x = longitude, y = latitude, color = AGR_ACN, size = H),
    shape = 16, alpha = 0.8
  ) +
  color_scale +
  scale_size_continuous(name = "Shannon index", range = c(0.1, 2.5)) +
  guides(color = "none",
         size  = guide_legend(order = 1)) +
  ggtitle("Oak species distribution")

map_plot <- (p1 | p2) / (p3 | p4) / legend_row +
  plot_layout(heights = c(1, 1, 0.01))

ggsave(
 here("output", "figures", "maps.pdf"),
 plot   = map_plot,
 width  = 5.5, height = 4, dpi = 300
)

detach("package:maps", unload = TRUE)
```

## Estimate Bayes Factors

```{r estimate_bf, include=TRUE}

run_bayes_analysis <- function(predictor, outcome, data) {

  dstat <- data %>%
    filter(!is.na(!!sym(predictor)), !is.na(!!sym(outcome)))

  null_priors <- c(
    prior(cauchy(0, 0.707), class = "Intercept"),
    prior(cauchy(0, 0.707), class = "sd", lb = 0)
  )

  full_priors <- c(
    prior(cauchy(0, 0.707), class = "b"),
    prior(cauchy(0, 0.707), class = "Intercept"),
    prior(cauchy(0, 0.707), class = "sd", lb = 0)
  )

  if (outcome %in% c("GOT", "GAT", "oak_system", "acorn_system")) {
    family_type <- bernoulli(link = "logit")
  } else if (outcome %in% c("SOT", "SAT") ) {
    family_type <- poisson(link = "log")
  }

  null_warns <- character(0)
  null_model <- withCallingHandlers(
    brm(
      formula = paste(outcome, "~ (1|family)"),
      data = dstat,
      family = family_type,
      prior = null_priors,
      save_pars = save_pars(all = TRUE),
      iter = 10000,
      control = list(adapt_delta = 0.95)
    ),
    warning = function(w) {
      null_warns <<- c(null_warns, conditionMessage(w))
      invokeRestart("muffleWarning")
    }
  )

  full_warns <- character(0)
  full_model <- withCallingHandlers(
    brm(
      formula = paste(outcome, "~", predictor, "+ (1|family)"),
      data = dstat,
      family = family_type,
      prior = full_priors,
      save_pars = save_pars(all = TRUE),
      iter = 10000,
      control = list(adapt_delta = 0.95)
    ),
    warning = function(w) {
      full_warns <<- c(full_warns, conditionMessage(w))
      invokeRestart("muffleWarning")
    }
  )

  bridge_null <- bridge_sampler(null_model)
  bridge_full <- bridge_sampler(full_model)

  BF_value <- bf(bridge_full, bridge_null)

  fe       <- fixef(full_model)
  pred_row <- fe[grepl(predictor, rownames(fe), fixed = TRUE), , drop = FALSE]

  summ <- tibble(
    outcome       = outcome,
    predictor     = predictor,
    BF            = BF_value$bf,
    estimate      = pred_row[1, "Estimate"],
    ci_lo         = pred_row[1, "Q2.5"],
    ci_hi         = pred_row[1, "Q97.5"],
    warnings_null = paste(null_warns, collapse = " | "),
    warnings_full = paste(full_warns, collapse = " | ")
  )

  return(summ)
}

# Factor levels
oakacorn$GOT <- factor(oakacorn$GOT, levels = c("absent",   "present"))
oakacorn$GAT <- factor(oakacorn$GAT, levels = c("absent",   "present"))
oakacorn$AGR <- factor(oakacorn$AGR, levels = c("forager",  "farmer"))
oakacorn$ACN <- factor(oakacorn$ACN, levels = c("non-user", "user"))

# oak_system: binary (spec.only vs two.level)
oakacorn_oak_sys <- oakacorn %>%
  filter(!is.na(oak_system)) %>%
  mutate(oak_system = factor(oak_system, levels = c("spec.only", "two.level")))

# acorn_system: collapsed to binary (gen.only vs other)
oakacorn_acorn_sys <- oakacorn %>%
  filter(!is.na(acorn_system)) %>%
  mutate(acorn_system = if_else(acorn_system == "gen.only", "gen.only", "other"),
         acorn_system = factor(acorn_system, levels = c("other", "gen.only")))

outcomes_data <- list(
  list(outcome = "GOT",          data = oakacorn),
  list(outcome = "SOT",          data = oakacorn),
  list(outcome = "GAT",          data = oakacorn),
  list(outcome = "SAT",          data = oakacorn),
  list(outcome = "oak_system",   data = oakacorn_oak_sys),
  list(outcome = "acorn_system", data = oakacorn_acorn_sys)
)

predictors <- c("AGR", "ACN", "n", "H")

output_path <- here("output", "results", "bayes_factor.csv")

completed <- if (file.exists(output_path)) {
  read_csv(output_path, show_col_types = FALSE)
} else {
  tibble()
}

all_combos <- expand_grid(
  seed    = 1:10,
  od_idx  = seq_along(outcomes_data),
  pred    = predictors
) %>%
  mutate(outcome = map_chr(od_idx, ~ outcomes_data[[.x]]$outcome))

if (nrow(completed) > 0) {
  all_combos <- all_combos %>%
    anti_join(completed %>% select(outcome, predictor, seed),
              by = c("outcome", "pred" = "predictor", "seed"))
}

cat(sprintf("Completed: %d  Remaining: %d\n",
            nrow(expand_grid(seed=1:10, od_idx=seq_along(outcomes_data), pred=predictors)) - nrow(all_combos),
            nrow(all_combos)))

for (i in seq_len(nrow(all_combos))) {
  row <- all_combos[i, ]
  od  <- outcomes_data[[row$od_idx]]
  cat(sprintf("[%d/%d] outcome=%s  predictor=%s  seed=%d\n",
              i, nrow(all_combos), od$outcome, row$pred, row$seed))
  set.seed(row$seed)
  result <- tryCatch(
    run_bayes_analysis(predictor = row$pred, outcome = od$outcome, data = od$data) %>%
      mutate(seed = row$seed),
    error = function(e) { cat(sprintf("  ERROR: %s\n", conditionMessage(e))); NULL }
  )
  if (!is.null(result)) {
    write_csv(result, output_path, append = file.exists(output_path))
  }
}
```

Make table:

```{r make table, include=TRUE}

label_outcomes <- c(
  "GOT"          = "oak generic",
  "SOT"          = "# oak specifics",
  "oak_system"   = "oak system",
  "GAT"          = "acorn generic",
  "SAT"          = "# acorn specifics",
  "acorn_system" = "acorn system"
)
label_predictors <- c(
  "AGR" = "subsistence",
  "ACN" = "acorn use",
  "n"   = "# species",
  "H"   = "Shannon index"
)

bf_symbol <- function(bf) {
  case_when(
    bf > 100          ~ "xxx",
    bf > 10           ~ "xx",
    bf > 3.2          ~ "x",
    bf >= 1 / 3.2     ~ "",
    bf >= 1 / 10      ~ "o",
    bf >= 1 / 100     ~ "oo",
    TRUE              ~ "ooo"
  )
}

raw <- read_csv(here("output", "results", "bayes_factor.csv"), show_col_types = FALSE)

# average BF per outcome and predictor
bf_avg <- raw %>%
  group_by(outcome, predictor) %>%
  summarise(avg_BF = mean(BF, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

# seed 9 is the only seed with no warnings for all 24 outcome-predictor combinations
clean_coef <- raw %>%
  filter(seed == 9) %>%
  select(outcome, predictor, seed_used = seed, estimate, ci_lo, ci_hi)

# sample size per outcome-predictor combination
sample_sizes <- expand_grid(
  outcome   = names(label_outcomes),
  predictor = names(label_predictors)
) %>%
  mutate(N = map2_int(outcome, predictor, function(o, p) {
    d <- if (o == "oak_system")   oakacorn %>% filter(!is.na(oak_system))
         else if (o == "acorn_system") oakacorn %>% filter(!is.na(acorn_system))
         else oakacorn
    sum(!is.na(d[[o]]) & !is.na(d[[p]]))
  }))

# build table
bayes_table <- bf_avg %>%
  left_join(clean_coef,   by = c("outcome", "predictor")) %>%
  left_join(sample_sizes, by = c("outcome", "predictor")) %>%
  mutate(
    symbol    = bf_symbol(avg_BF),
    avg_BF    = round(avg_BF, 2),
    estimate  = round(estimate, 2),
    CI        = paste0("[", round(ci_lo, 2), ", ", round(ci_hi, 2), "]"),
    outcome   = recode(outcome,   !!!label_outcomes),
    predictor = recode(predictor, !!!label_predictors),
    outcome   = factor(outcome,   levels = unname(label_outcomes)),
    predictor = factor(predictor, levels = unname(label_predictors))
  ) %>%
  arrange(outcome, predictor) %>%
  mutate(outcome = if_else(is.na(lag(outcome)) | outcome != lag(outcome),
                           as.character(outcome), "")) %>%
  select(outcome, predictor, N, avg_BF, symbol, estimate, CI)

table_obj <- xtable(bayes_table, digits = c(0, 0, 0, 0, 2, 0, 2, 2))
print(table_obj, file = here("output", "tables", "oak_acorn.tex"),
      include.rownames = FALSE, sanitize.text.function = identity,
      timestamp = NULL)

# BF values across all seeds (seeds as columns)
bf_seeds <- raw %>%
  mutate(
    outcome   = recode(outcome,   !!!label_outcomes),
    predictor = recode(predictor, !!!label_predictors),
    outcome   = factor(outcome,   levels = unname(label_outcomes)),
    predictor = factor(predictor, levels = unname(label_predictors))
  ) %>%
  arrange(outcome, predictor, seed) %>%
  select(outcome, predictor, seed, BF) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = seed, values_from = BF, names_prefix = "seed_") %>%
  mutate(outcome = if_else(is.na(lag(outcome)) | outcome != lag(outcome),
                           as.character(outcome), ""))

bf_seeds_obj <- xtable(bf_seeds, digits = c(0, 0, 0, rep(2, ncol(bf_seeds) - 2)))
print(bf_seeds_obj, file = here("output", "tables", "bayes_factors.tex"),
      include.rownames = FALSE, sanitize.text.function = identity,
      timestamp = NULL)

# named vector of BF symbols for figure annotations
# GOT/GAT are stored as "GOT_bin"/"GAT_bin" in panel keys, so remap here
bf_annot <- bf_avg %>%
  mutate(
    outcome_key = case_when(
      outcome == "GOT" ~ "GOT_bin",
      outcome == "GAT" ~ "GAT_bin",
      TRUE             ~ outcome
    ),
    symbol = bf_symbol(avg_BF),
    key    = paste0(outcome_key, "_", predictor)
  ) %>%
  { setNames(.$symbol, .$key) }
```

```{r fig1_domain_presence, include=TRUE}
add_signif <- function(p, label, vjust = 1, side = "right") {
  if (is.na(label) || nchar(label) == 0) return(p)
  sz <- 3.5
  if (side == "left") {
    p + annotate("text", x = -Inf, y = Inf, label = label,
                 hjust = -0.2, vjust = vjust, size = sz)
  } else {
    p + annotate("text", x = Inf, y = Inf, label = label,
                 hjust = 1.2, vjust = vjust, size = sz)
  }
}

oakacorn_plot <- oakacorn %>%
  mutate(
    oak_system   = factor(oak_system,   levels = c("gen.only","spec.only","two.level"), ordered = TRUE),
    acorn_system = factor(acorn_system, levels = c("gen.only","spec.only","two.level"), ordered = TRUE),
    GOT     = factor(GOT, levels = c("absent","present"), ordered = TRUE),
    GAT     = factor(GAT, levels = c("absent","present"), ordered = TRUE),
    AGR     = factor(AGR, levels = c("forager","farmer"),  ordered = TRUE),
    ACN     = factor(ACN, levels = c("non-user","user"),   ordered = TRUE)
  )

# Bootstrap 95% CI for proportion of "present" in a group
boot_prop_ci <- function(x, R = 1000, seed = 42) {
  set.seed(seed)
  x_bin <- as.integer(x == "present")
  boots  <- replicate(R, mean(sample(x_bin, length(x_bin), replace = TRUE)))
  data.frame(
    n     = length(x_bin),
    prop  = mean(x_bin),
    ci_lo = unname(quantile(boots, 0.025)),
    ci_hi = unname(quantile(boots, 0.975))
  )
}

compute_bars <- function(df, group_var, outcome_var, R = 1000, seed = 42) {
  df %>%
    filter(!is.na(.data[[group_var]]), !is.na(.data[[outcome_var]])) %>%
    group_by(group = .data[[group_var]]) %>%
    group_modify(~ boot_prop_ci(.x[[outcome_var]], R = R, seed = seed)) %>%
    ungroup()
}

make_bar_panel <- function(df, group_var, outcome_var, x_label, y_label) {
  bars <- compute_bars(df, group_var, outcome_var)

  ggplot(bars, aes(x = group, y = prop, fill = group)) +
    geom_col(alpha = 0.85, width = 0.5) +
    geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = ci_lo, ymax = ci_hi),
                  color = "#636363", width = 0.2, linewidth = 0.9) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = group_colors) +
    scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 1)) +
    labs(x = x_label, y = y_label) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +
    theme(panel.grid = element_blank(), legend.position = "none", axis.text.x = element_text(size = 11))
}

make_density_panel <- function(df, x_var, outcome_var, x_label, y_label = "density") {
  d <- df %>% filter(!is.na(.data[[x_var]]), !is.na(.data[[outcome_var]]))

  ggplot(d, aes(x = .data[[x_var]], fill = .data[[outcome_var]])) +
    geom_density(alpha = 0.4, linewidth = 0.8, color = NA) +

    theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +
    theme(panel.grid = element_blank(),
          legend.key  = element_rect(color = NA, fill = NA),
          legend.title = element_text(size = 11),
          legend.text  = element_text(size = 11))
}
```

```{r fig2_domain_specifics, include=TRUE}
compute_mean_bars <- function(df, group_var, outcome_var, n_boot = 1000, seed = 42) {
  set.seed(seed)
  df %>%
    filter(!is.na(.data[[group_var]]), !is.na(.data[[outcome_var]])) %>%
    group_by(group = .data[[group_var]]) %>%
    summarise(
      n     = n(),
      mean  = mean(.data[[outcome_var]]),
      ci_lo = {
        x <- .data[[outcome_var]]
        boot_means <- replicate(n_boot, mean(sample(x, length(x), replace = TRUE)))
        quantile(boot_means, 0.025)
      },
      ci_hi = {
        x <- .data[[outcome_var]]
        boot_means <- replicate(n_boot, mean(sample(x, length(x), replace = TRUE)))
        quantile(boot_means, 0.975)
      },
      .groups = "drop"
    )
}

make_mean_bar_panel <- function(df, group_var, outcome_var, x_label, y_label) {
  bars <- compute_mean_bars(df, group_var, outcome_var)

  ggplot(bars, aes(x = group, y = mean, fill = group)) +
    geom_col(alpha = 0.85, width = 0.5) +
    geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = ci_lo, ymax = ci_hi),
                  color = "#636363", width = 0.2, linewidth = 0.9) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = group_colors) +
    labs(x = x_label, y = y_label) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +
    theme(panel.grid = element_blank(), legend.position = "none", axis.text.x = element_text(size = 11))
}

make_scatter_panel <- function(df, x_var, outcome_var, x_label, y_label, family = "lm") {
  d <- df %>% filter(!is.na(.data[[x_var]]), !is.na(.data[[outcome_var]]))

  smooth_layer <- if (family == "poisson") {
    geom_smooth(method = "glm", method.args = list(family = poisson(link = "log")),
                se = TRUE, color = "#2171b5", fill = "#9ecae1")
  } else if (family == "nb") {
    geom_smooth(method = MASS::glm.nb, se = TRUE, color = "#2171b5", fill = "#9ecae1")
  } else {
    geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = TRUE, color = "#2171b5", fill = "#9ecae1")
  }

  ggplot(d, aes(x = .data[[x_var]], y = .data[[outcome_var]])) +
    geom_jitter(width = 0, height = 0.15, alpha = 0.5, size = 2, color = "#636363") +
    smooth_layer +
    labs(x = x_label, y = y_label) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +
    theme(panel.grid = element_blank())
}
```

```{r fig3_system_type, include=TRUE}
system_colors <- c(
  "gen.only"  = "#67a9cf",
  "spec.only" = "#9970ab",
  "two.level" = "#ef8a62",
  "other"     = "#ef8a62"

make_system_pairwise_panel <- function(df, group_var, outcome_var, x_label, y_label) {
  sys_levels   <- levels(droplevels(df[[outcome_var]][!is.na(df[[outcome_var]])]))
  group_levels <- levels(df[[group_var]])

  d <- df %>% filter(!is.na(.data[[group_var]]), !is.na(.data[[outcome_var]]))
  bars <- expand_grid(sys_type = sys_levels, grp = group_levels) %>%
    mutate(pmap_dfr(list(sys_type, grp), function(s, g) {
      x     <- d[[outcome_var]][d[[group_var]] == g]
      is_s  <- as.integer(x == s)
      boots <- replicate(1000, mean(sample(is_s, length(is_s), replace = TRUE)))
      tibble(prop = mean(is_s),
             ci_lo = unname(quantile(boots, 0.025)),
             ci_hi = unname(quantile(boots, 0.975)))
    })) %>%
    mutate(sys_type = factor(sys_type, levels = sys_levels),
           grp      = factor(grp, levels = group_levels))

  g_colors <- if (group_var == "AGR") {
    c("forager" = "#9ecae1", "farmer" = "#2171b5")
  } else {
    c("non-user" = "#9ecae1", "user" = "#2171b5")
  }

  ggplot(bars, aes(x = sys_type, y = prop, fill = grp)) +
    geom_col(position = position_dodge(0.7), alpha = 0.85, width = 0.65) +
    geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = ci_lo, ymax = ci_hi),
                  position = position_dodge(0.7), width = 0.2, linewidth = 0.7,
                  color = "#333333") +
    scale_fill_manual(values = g_colors, name = x_label) +
    scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent_format(),
                       limits = c(0, 1),
                       expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.1))) +
    labs(x = "system type", y = y_label) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +
    theme(panel.grid = element_blank(), legend.position = "top", legend.key.size = unit(0.4, "cm"),
          legend.key  = element_rect(color = NA, fill = NA),
          legend.title = element_blank(), legend.text  = element_text(size = 8))
}

make_system_density_panel <- function(df, x_var, outcome_var, x_label, y_label = "density") {
  d <- df %>% filter(!is.na(.data[[x_var]]), !is.na(.data[[outcome_var]]))

  ggplot(d, aes(x = .data[[x_var]], fill = .data[[outcome_var]])) +
    geom_density(alpha = 0.35, linewidth = 0.8, color = NA) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = system_colors, name = "system type",
                      guide = guide_legend(override.aes = list(color = NA, linewidth = 0))) +
    labs(x = x_label, y = y_label) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +
    theme(panel.grid = element_blank(), legend.position = c(0.85, 0.85),
          legend.key  = element_rect(color = NA, fill = NA),
          legend.title = element_blank(), legend.text  = element_text(size = 8),
          legend.key.size = unit(0.4, "cm")
)
}
```

## Permutation test

```{r permutation_gat_got, include=TRUE}
perm_data <- oakacorn %>%
  filter(!is.na(GOT), !is.na(GAT)) %>%
  distinct(glottocode, GOT, GAT) %>%
  mutate(
    got_present = as.integer(GOT == "present"),
    gat_present = as.integer(GAT == "present")
  )

obs_diff <- mean(perm_data$gat_present) - mean(perm_data$got_present)

set.seed(42)
n_perm <- 10000
perm_diffs <- replicate(n_perm, {
  swapped   <- rbinom(nrow(perm_data), 1, 0.5)
  gat_perm  <- ifelse(swapped, perm_data$got_present, perm_data$gat_present)
  got_perm  <- ifelse(swapped, perm_data$gat_present, perm_data$got_present)
  mean(gat_perm) - mean(got_perm)
})

# add-one correction (Phipson & Smyth 2010): avoids p = 0 when no permuted
# value meets or exceeds the observed; lower bound is 1/(n_perm + 1)
p_val <- (sum(perm_diffs >= obs_diff) + 1) / (n_perm + 1)
print(p_val)
```

## Explore NAEB

```{r naeb_mapping, include=TRUE}

# assign parts of the tree that is used
naeb_raw <- naeb_raw %>%
  mutate(usage_part = case_when(
    str_detect(tolower(notes), "acorn|\\bnuts?\\b|fruits?") ~ "acorn",
    str_detect(tolower(notes), "bark")         ~ "bark",
    str_detect(tolower(notes), "\\blogs?\\b")  ~ "log",
    str_detect(tolower(notes), "branches?")    ~ "branch",
    str_detect(tolower(notes), "plants?")      ~ "plant",
    str_detect(tolower(notes), "wood")         ~ "wood",
    str_detect(tolower(notes), "leaves|leaf")  ~ "leaves",
    str_detect(tolower(notes), "young growth") ~ "young growth",
    str_detect(tolower(notes), "gums?")        ~ "gum",
    str_detect(tolower(notes), "roots?")       ~ "root",
    str_detect(tolower(notes), "galls?")       ~ "gall",
    str_detect(tolower(notes), "seeds?")       ~ "seed",
    str_detect(tolower(notes), "twigs?")       ~ "twig",
    str_detect(tolower(notes), "shoots?")      ~ "shoot",
    str_detect(tolower(notes), "withes?")      ~ "withe",
    str_detect(tolower(notes), "trunks?")      ~ "trunk",
    str_detect(tolower(notes), "sticks?")      ~ "stick",
    str_detect(tolower(notes), "pitch")        ~ "pitch",
    str_detect(tolower(notes), "poles?")       ~ "pole",
    str_detect(tolower(notes), "charcoal")     ~ "charcoal",
    TRUE ~ "unspecified"
  )) %>%
  mutate(usage_part_binary = if_else(usage_part == "acorn", "acorn", "other"))

length(unique(naeb_raw$culture)) # 93 has recorded use of oak
table(naeb_raw$usage_part) # acorn is most commonly used (about half), bark is second most commonly used
table(naeb_raw$use_category, naeb_raw$usage_part) # acorn is mostly used for food, bark is mostly used for drug
check <- table(naeb_raw$use_subcategory, naeb_raw$usage_part)
check_tbl <- as_tibble(as.data.frame(check)) # acorn is mostly used for porridge, bread, soup
# bark is mostly used for skin, stomach and intestines, and throat
# some notes appear different, they mean the same thing 

acorn_usage <- naeb_raw %>%
  filter(usage_part_binary == "acorn")

acorn_mixing <- acorn_usage %>%
  filter(use_category == "Food") %>%
  group_by(culture, use_subcategory) %>%
  summarise(
    n_species   = n_distinct(scientific_name),
    species     = paste(sort(unique(scientific_name)), collapse = ", "),
    has_sp      = any(scientific_name == "Quercus sp."),
    .groups     = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(mixed = n_species > 1 | has_sp)
# cultures seem to mix acorns from different species together to make various food
```
